in_marathi.name: Bhandari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhandari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhandari is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bhanda' meaning servant and 'Ri' meaning Lord Vishnu. This name is associated with devotion and service to the divine. In Hindu mythology, the Bhandaris were a community of temple servants and musicians dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
